issue.title: Replace github.com/vmihailenco/msgpack/v5
issue.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

msgpack v5.4.1 is flagged for CVE-2026-2454, and upstream has been inactive since 2023, so a fix is unlikely.

### Proposed solution

gh only uses msgpack to encode `PR_`, `U_` and `DC_` node IDs from small int arrays. A ~20-line encoder in `api` produces identical output and drops the dependency. PR: #14801.

@williammartin Yes, it's https://github.com/vmihailenco/msgpack/issues/401. CVE-2026-2454 is that decoder bug. You're right that gh never decodes, so it isn't reachable.

The reason I care is Snyk. I build a container image that includes the `gh` binary, and the scan flags msgpack v5.4.1 inside it. It matches the linked version, so the finding stays even though nothing decodes. The msgpack repo hasn't had a commit since 2023, so I don't expect them to take a fix.
